coverage.name: Archuleta County
limitations: Read the official 2026 Archuleta County General Election sample ballot PDF (clerk states it combines all ballot styles and contains all ballot issues). Local questions on it: County 1A, School District 50JT 5A, Upper San Juan Health Service District 7B.

Excluded: Archuleta County Ballot Issue 1A - raises county lodging tax (short-term accommodations, excluding the Town of Pagosa Springs) from 2% to 6%; revenue split 80% county roads, 10% public safety/emergency dispatch, 10% childcare for local workforce; no housing earmark. Exclusion confirmed by owner decision (2026-09-26).
Excluded: School District 50JT Ballot Issue 5A - school bond/debt ($79,900,000) for school facilities; not housing.
Excluded: Upper San Juan Health Service District Ballot Issue 7B - general revenue retention (de-Brucing) for the health service district; no housing earmark.
No TABOR notice or participating-entities list/IGA was posted on the county clerk election pages as of 2026-09-26.

coverage.name: Pagosa Springs (town)
limitations: No participating-entities list/IGA for the Nov 3, 2026 coordinated election was posted by the Archuleta County Clerk as of 2026-09-26, so participation could not be confirmed from a list; state is based on reading the county's combined sample ballot, which the clerk says contains all ballot issues across all ballot styles and shows no Town of Pagosa Springs question.

Town Clerk page (checked 2026-09-26) shows no Nov 3, 2026 town election or ballot measure; the town's regular municipal election was held April 2026. Town Public Notices page (checked 2026-09-26) lists only Ordinances 1039/1040, neither a ballot referral.
County Ballot Issue 1A (lodging tax) expressly excludes the Town of Pagosa Springs and is not housing-earmarked; not an entry for the town.
www.pagosasprings.co.gov intermittently reset connections through the proxy; pages were read after retries.
